name: After § 15
title: REPORT on the situation of fundamental rights in the European Union in 2024 and 2025
part_text: 15a. Stresses that corruption is not only a violation of the law but also a concrete violation of fundamental rights since it diverts public funding away from health, education and social services, hence exacerbating inequalities and reducing effective access for the most vulnerable segments of the population to the rights guaranteed by the Charter; calls on the Commission and the Member States therefore to adopt an integrated approach to combating corruption that explicitly includes the fundamental rights dimension, to strengthen mechanisms for the recovery of illegally acquired assets and to ensure their restoration to the community through funds dedicated to replenishing public services that have suffered losses;
